about: The worked examples beside a condition on the canvas. ExpressionHelpTest (server) parses and checks each one against these columns, so every example shown works as written.

examples.says: Nested: brackets group a test, and and binds tighter than or.

examples.text: country in ('GB', 'IE') and signed_up between date '2024-01-01' and date '2024-12-31'
examples.says: One of a list, and a range with both ends included.

examples.text: email like '%@example.com' and status is not null
examples.says: A text pattern (% is any run of characters), and a value that is not empty.
